entry.title: Rate Every Category
entry.learningObjective: Rate the cigar across 6 categories (Appearance/Construction/Draw/Burn/Flavor/Pairing Match) with real per-category guidance.
entry.canonicalPersistence: smokecraft_activity_attempts (activity_type=scorecard, activity_key=scorecard); smokecraft_tasting_drafts (activityKey=scorecard, shared with Package A/Mini Tasting)
entry.notes: Required-Interaction Closure Package B: all 6 categories must be rated and are validated server-side (range 1-5, real vocabulary) before completion; the server independently computes and owns the weighted overall score (the client can no longer submit its own overall/passed/xpEarned). Reuses the exact same evidence ledger and draft table/routes established by Package A — no second scoring system. Verified end-to-end via API and real-browser tests, including cross-player/cross-session isolation, concurrency, and stale-draft-after-completion rejection.
